about: Intended differences from the reference inventory, per screen (docs/VISUAL_REDESIGN.md 8.6 step 3). Each change removes a run of reference controls and puts its insert in their place, or inserts before a reference control; with insertWhen, the inserted controls are expected exactly when that selector matches a visible element on the screen. Edited only by the wave's owner of scripts/verify, signed off by the wave's integrator, with the same delta recorded in 8.6.

deltas.reason: The platform themes are retired (OD-7) and their block becomes the Icon pack picker (OD-4); Modern is the first color scheme (OD-7).

changes.reason: Platform Theme block removed; the Icon pack section takes its place (R1-FOUNDATION) and must be there
Modern is the first color scheme card

deltas.reason: The Home dashboard of docs/DASHBOARD.md replaces the old one (its section 4). Shot 40's state: only the pinned Home tab and no connection history, so Recently connected and Open now hide; no audit log, fresh passwords and no backups, so AI activity and Needs attention hide. Type labels drop CSS uppercase (8.4 rule 1).

changes.reason: The pinned Home tab sits before the tab bar's right-hand buttons (DASHBOARD.md 3.1)
Customize joins the header; the quick bar is the search box, Quick Connect and New Entry (DASHBOARD.md 4.1, 4.2)
Favorites rows: type label in title case, then Copy password and View info (DASHBOARD.md 4.5)
Recently Modified is gone; Recently connected takes its place and hides without history (DASHBOARD.md 2, 4.3)
The card title is in sentence case (DASHBOARD.md 4.8)
